requiredEvidence: On-route mapped bedrock sample or at least two consistent local off-route GSJ samples
decisionLogic: Do not discard bedrock because unconsolidated cover wins the route-wide majority. Resolve bedrock identity among bedrock evidence only. Ambiguous granitic group remains granitic rocks, not a specific petrographic species. Replace the generic sediment display base with this inferred substrate. Do not create an extra conformable granite bed.
